# cubepath_network_bgp_peer (Resource)

Manages a BGP peer (Dynamic Routes) of a private network: an eBGP session between the network gateway (AS 64512) and a router inside the network, which announces the prefixes it can reach. The network needs at least one server attached. Up to 8 peers per network. Import with network_id:peer_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the private network. Changing it forces a new peer.
- `peer_target` (String) An IP address inside the network, or the ID of a VPS or baremetal server attached to it. Changing it forces a new peer.
- `peer_type` (String) How the neighbor is given: ip, vps or baremetal. Changing it forces a new peer.
- `remote_asn` (Number) AS number of the neighbor, not 64512. Changing it forces a new peer.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the session is configured. Defaults to true.
- `max_prefix` (Number) Maximum prefixes accepted from the neighbor, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the peer.
- `resolved_peer_ip` (String) IP address of the neighbor.
- `state` (String) Last observed BGP session state (for example Established).
